venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Monday 10/19 (MOD MKZ; posted 8:35pm 10/19).** Net $841 vs $817 target. Food $226 (close to goal; 12 Meal Deals, Meal Deal extended to all day Mondays). Comps $34.60 (community/investor $9.60, industry $20.60, employee discount $4.40). 25 guests, $33.64 check avg. Steady slow volume, peak 8pm; pumpkin decorating drew a lined bar of industry friends and regulars. John Morrow's first training day. BOH kept ticket times and cleaning on track. Maintenance: drain enzyme ordered; glassware delivery pending. 86: Arette blanco/repo, Grey Goose, High Life ponies, Sprite. No incidents.
